preconditions.description: The number of elements in the array is between 1 and 10,000, inclusive.
Each element in the array is between 1 and 10,000, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output list has the same length as the input array.

postconditions.expression: all(answer[i] == -1 or 1 <= answer[i] <= n for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each element in the output list is either -1 or a valid index within the input array.

postconditions.expression: all(arr.count(arr[i]) == freq[arr[i]] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The frequency of each element in the input array is correctly calculated.

postconditions.expression: all(any(freq[arr[j]] > freq[arr[i]] for j in range(i+1, n)) or answer[i] == -1 for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For each element in the input array, the output is the index of the next element on its right with a greater frequency, or -1 if no such element exists.
